 MEMO
 To:       Honorable Mayor Patrick Collins and Members of the City Council
 From:     Connor White, Planner II
 Subject: PUDC-23-63 / Sweetgrass PUD / PUD Amendment / Substitute Exhibit A
 Date:    September 6, 2023

The applicant has been working with Staff on some additional corrections needed to the proposed PUD
Amendment. The substitute Exhibit A is the final version of the Sweetgrass PUD that addresses Staffs
concerns. The new exhibit is a clean version and has no red text as it is the final version for the
ordinance. The applicant has provided a comparison document that details the changes made for this
final version. The highlighted text in the comparison document is what has changed. The Ordinance
itself has not changed.

Attachments:
    1. Comparison Document
    2. Substitute Exhibit A
